name: Worktree and Branch Model
description: Map workspaces to git worktrees. Each workspace corresponds to a worktree with its own working directory, index, and HEAD. Support branch tracking with automatic detection of branch switches. Implement dirty detection against the worktree state and integrate with git stash for managing in-progress work during branch switches.
purpose: Workspaces need a concrete filesystem representation. Git worktrees provide isolated working directories that are natively linked to the repository. This enables parallel workspaces on different branches without branch-switching overhead. Dirty detection prevents data loss during context switches.
acceptanceCriteria: Each workspace maps to one git worktree
Branch tracking: workspace state includes tracked branch name and HEAD commit
Automatic detection of branch switches via worktree HEAD change
Dirty detection: detect uncommitted changes in the worktree working directory and index
Stash integration: auto-stash on context switch when worktree is dirty
Stash recovery: restore stashed state when switching back
Branch creation and checkout within a workspace updates worktree state
